feeds.title: Transformative Adventures
feeds.description: Transformative Adventures is an emerging non-profit cooperative organization. Here you can find inspiration, information, self-guided adventures to transform your life, and programs and materials you can use to transform your community.

feeds.title: Forest Garden Blog
feeds.description: At Forest, we know a fair bit about fences; And sheds for that matter. We've been the UK's leading and most trusted manufacturer and distributor of quality wooden garden products for over 50 years. Today, you'll find our range of garden buildings, fencing, decking, and decorative structures for sale across many sites online and in over 3,000 retail stores.

feeds.title: Anni's Perennial Veggies
feeds.description: This blog began in 2011 as a record of my experiments with growing perennial vegetables in polycultures. Over time the focus has expanded from perennial vegetables, to include much more focused thought and attention on forest gardens as a whole and also to consider woodlands and other related topics as they arise.

feeds.title: Landed Garden Blog
feeds.description: Landed Garden is a concept of edible forest garden based on permaculture principles and is modeled on natural woodland but on a smaller scale. This Landed Garden blog follows the development of a small edible forest garden in Salisbury, Wiltshire, first planted in the winter of 2008.

feeds.title: Food Forest Living Blog
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Rachelle, with a life-long passion & education for high-quality food, I received the space & opportunity to grow it myself. I am sharing everything I learn & do on this site to help with your homestead too.Simplifying Life With Quality Food & Close Community

feeds.title: Forest Garden Blog
feeds.description: Forest Garden blog began as a way to share information with friends and neighbors facing many of the same gardening challenges we face, in similar circumstances. Since then it has continued to share documents for the turning of the seasons in photographs, and to share poetry, book reviews, essays on gardening topics, favorite quotations from other authors, and the occasional recipe with the followers of Forest Garden.

feeds.title: A Food Forest in your Garden
feeds.description: This page is about a food forest garden in an Aberdeen allotment. The core of this site is a collection of plant portraits, covering the propagation, growing, harvesting, storing, and eating of individual plants used in forest gardening.

feeds.title: Edimentals » Forest Gardening
feeds.description: Learn about forest gardening including alpine plants, beans, cellar vegetables, and coastal plants. Edimentals is a small nursery based in North Falmouth, Maine. We specialize in plants that are edible and ornamental.

feeds.title: Medicinal Forest Garden Trust Blog
feeds.description: The Medicinal Forest Garden Trust aims to promote education and research toward sustainable cultivation and to harvest medicinal trees and shrubs. Through courses and projects, we seek to support the establishment of sustainable cultivation and harvesting of medicinal trees and shrubs. We can offer advice and support for the sustainable design of therapeutic aspects of forest gardens.
